So the closed form must be built in **leg variables** (truncated-power spline) or as an explicit symmetric ansatz — not by per-region invariant fitting.

**Verdict: not SOLVED** — the explicit degree-11 spline numerator $N_6$ (and all-$n$) remains the whole open problem; no `SOLVED.md`.
